subject: Kickoff: TextGenSHAP explanation service for RAG answers
body:
Hi all,

Kicking off the long-doc interpretability track. Our TextGenSHAP release computes scalable post-hoc explanations for text generation over long documents using hierarchical Shapley and Banzhaf values. Product angle for graphs-retrieval: when our retrieval-augmented systems answer from a 100-passage context, customers ask "which passage made it say that?" — this is that answer, per token if needed.

Milestones:
- Apr 10: minimal experiment green (run.sh) plus the NQ embedding/retrieval path (psgs_w100, top-100).
- May 22: FiD model loaded, NQ Shapley interpretations and MirACL Banzhaf interpretations reproduced.
- Jul 17: attribution-quality readout on our production RAG traffic sample.

Bao owns staffing and the compute reservation — the hierarchical attribution sweeps are accelerator-hungry. Rafael is research lead.

Anders
